items.title: The exclusive row's 'unique production source' does not match the production wiring and omits two alternate injection paths
items.fact: identity-auth/design.md:3616 names POSIX file lock / restoreDeploymentExclusive as the unique production source. But restoreDeploymentExclusive has no production construction site (only recovery_exclusive.go:15-42 and tests); main.go:634-636 leaves recoveryRootInputs.exclusive nil; recovery_runtime.go:551 uses newRecoveryAnchorRegistry(nil), :555 resolves it, and :647 injects recoveryClosedPort (recovery_sources.go:470-474, :523-531). A second path exists through recoveryAnchorAdapter.Exclusive (recovery_sources.go:425-430, :458-461, :485-491) and inputs.exclusive override (recovery_runtime.go:565-567).
items.impact: Closure condition 1 (unique production source per port) is not satisfied at the contract level; S4.22 cannot determine a single injection path; a future registered adapter could change the deployment-lock source and violate ADR-0032's root/platform ownership. Production is still closed, so no live exposure, hence MEDIUM rather than HIGH.
items.recommendation: State current production = empty-registry recoveryClosedPort; future sole authorized path = root injecting restoreDeploymentExclusive into recoveryRootInputs.exclusive; explicitly exclude recoveryAnchorAdapter.Exclusive as a production deployment-lock source (or record it as the sole path and reconcile ADR-0032 ownership). Align framework.md:1060 and :1113. Do not modify ADR-0019/0030/0031 text.
items.disposition: must fix in this D04 round; blocking for design PASS
